_meta.note: T-60 layer 2. Policy + lock -> accept or reject. Every `expect` is written by hand from the policy as specified; nothing here is derived from an implementation. A refused lock has exactly one fault, except in a step that names `faults`, where every reader names the earlier one: all three check in one order. `target` and `signer` are symbolic: each reader resolves them against its own rig. `evmPolicyHex` is null for a policy no chain can install (`whitelistOnly`). Each reader runs the cases that name it and asserts it ran `counts[reader]`; for every other case it asserts `skips[reader]` gives the reason it cannot. A `request` step is several locks under one agent authorization (one Soroban `__check_auth`, one EVM batch UserOperation): judged in order against running buckets, refused whole.
